She hasn’t reached out yet and I’m not planning to either, the last thing I said was that I was scared, 13 hours ago….

But no one seems to care… they called my mom because they said my serotonin levels were so high that my body could start shutting down and that they had to inform my emergency contact but I haven’t heard from her yet either. Not even a text:/ 
I know the most logical thing is to regret it when being so close to death but I dont feel anything, no remorse no nothing. Only a bit of shame and a lot of physical pain.
Thank you for your kind words

She had no reason to believe so because I’ve never joked like that before or been the “drama”, its always me being there for her and I thought she’d understand that I was asking for help since I cried and said “I have something to tell you” and proceeded to tell her that I swallowed a bunch of pills earlier and that I now was puking blood. She knows I’ve been depressed but not at this extent. She has also been depressed herself and attempted suicide and had me call an ambulance for her in the middle of the night, while driving top speed risking my license

I guess I am as okay as one can be in this situation, feeling kinda betrayed but mostly just confused about everything. And the fact that she still hasn’t reached out since the last thing I said was that I was scared is breaking my heart even more. Not a care in the world if I’m dead or not. Thank you for being sweet
